650214.name: Water & Woods Braided Rope Slip Dog Leash, Green
650214.description: Water & Woods Braided Rope Slip Dog Leash, Green; Your pup will be the bark of the town wearing the fetching Water & Woods Braided Rope Slip Dog Leash! This leash-collar combo is made from soft, flexible braided rope for added comfort. It also features leather slides that allow you to adjust to find the right fit for your paw-some pup. It's paw-fect for crate transfers, field trials, or everyday walks! Made from soft, durable braided rope material! Features a two-in-one collar and leash combination. Features leather slides that allow for sizing adjustments. Can be used for crate transfers, field trials, or everyday walks. Available in multiple colors!

2103910.name: Canine Canyon Rover Rescue Dog Carry Support Harness, Bright Blue
2103910.description: **Remember to measure your pet for the perfect fit.** Pet parents, get ready for any adventure with the Canine Canyon Rover Rescue Dog Carry Support Harness. Designed to provide ultimate assistance and convenience for both you and your furry friend, this harness is crafted with padded, breathable air mesh for superior comfort and ventilation. Its versatile design allows you to wear it on your front or back, adapting to your needs for ultimate ease and accessibility. With durable buckles and sturdy straps, it's ready for any adventure and offers the reliability you need when conditions get demanding. This multi-purpose rescue harness gives you peace of mind whether you're assisting an older dog, carrying a pup over difficult terrain, or evacuating during emergencies.

3588422.name: Ruffwear BackTrak Evacuation Kit Dog Harness, Cloudburst Gray, Large
3588422.description: **Remember to measure your pet for the perfect fit.** Be prepared for emergencies with the Ruffwear BackTrak Evacuation Kit Dog Harness. This kit includes a lightweight first-aid muzzle and a human vest with a built-in dog-carrying sling, making it perfect for unexpected situations where your furry friend may need assistance. The first-aid muzzle is adjustable and easy to secure behind your BFF’s ears, while the human vest features adjustable waist, chest, and lightly padded shoulder straps for a comfortable fit. The continuous-support webbing straps help distribute weight, and the color-coded adjustable straps on the dog sling make it easy to attach your dog in either the front or back. Please practice using the kit before your next adventure to ensure success in case of an emergency. Sizing is based on your dog’s girth size, while the human vest measurements are the same for all sizes: The chest strap fits up to 67" (170 cm), and the waist strap fits up to 79" (200 cm).

3598582.name: Non-stop Dogwear Dog Rescue Sling, Orange, Medium
3598582.description: Be prepared for emergencies with the Non-stop Dogwear Dog Rescue Sling. This compact and ultralight sling is an essential tool for carrying injured or unable-to-walk dogs back to safety. Developed in collaboration with the Norwegian Search and Rescue Dog Association, this sling is built to withstand challenging conditions and provide reliable support. Its universal fit allows you to quickly and securely place your furbaby without needing to make adjustments, while the weight distribution minimizes strain for you as the handler. Plus, it comes with a small mesh compression bag for easy packing and carrying on any hike. Don’t leave home without this indispensable addition to your dog’s first aid kit.
